semantic_scholar.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) often exhibit complex failure modes, which frequently cause agents to produce incorrect outcomes. This motivates the task of Agent Failure Attribution: given a failed multi-agent trajectory, identify the faulty agents and their corresponding error types.
